criteria.note: The QA report (lines 68 and 164) records ci:fast, which test:remote runs, at 8955 tests and 0 fail, and bundle:check at 129 skills and 0 problems, both at 1de74ff6c8d7. finalise-delta docs-only from 1de74ff6c8d7 to HEAD 9c1a872 returned tree-equivalent (exit 0): the only changes are 5 files in the task directory. On every PR, test.yml:58 runs npm test (the same suite), and validate.yml:128 runs bundle_skill.py --check, triggered on skills/** and shared/resources/** changes, both of which this PR touches. The caller reports CI green at 1de74ff6c8d7. RERUN_AT_HEAD is none, so no command was re-run at head.

I read CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] (line 5). Lines 36 to 41 name both § 5 changes: Breaking Change 1, a .git: stream segment or a C1 control is now code, so the pipelines wait for CI; Breaking Change 2, an exclusion holding a C1 control is a usage error naming the key (exit 2). Line 32 replaces 'extglob' with 'an extglob group (`@(`, `!(` or `+(`)'. changelog-cites.test.mjs checks fixtures only and does not pin this text.
